violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: An employee was observed serving ready-to-eat foods by scooping the foods with disposable gloves, on multiple different food items without replacing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and for one ready-to-eat food/meal item. PROVIDE A SUITABLE SERVING UTENSILS FOR EACH FOOD/MEAL ITEM ON THE BUFFET TABLE, TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:fried tilapia=101F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:kimchi=55F, collard green salad=70F, bean salad=68F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: flour and other hard to identify foods, in unmarked containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The labels must be in English language plus any other language of your choice.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: The food on display is not protected from contamination. The foods served on the bluffer style table are not protected from possible contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards/sneeze guards, display cases, or other effective means.
